description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT-based system. It includes functions for image verification, partition handling, copying configuration to partitions, updating EFI system partitions, and performing the overall upgrade process with detailed device and partition management.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and consistency of a system upgrade image by comparing partition tables.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a designated partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI system partition files (EFI boot files) from the upgrade image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade procedure that manages partition updates, writes the image to device partitions, and updates configuration and EFI files.
